extDescription.message: Finds the videos on a web page and saves them as files: MP4, HLS and DASH streams, plus bilibili in your account's best quality. No servers, no tracking.

disclaimer.message: Only for videos you have the right to save. DRM-protected content and YouTube are not supported. Not affiliated with any site.

emptyPage.message: Open a web page with a video first.

blockedSite.message: Spool does not download from YouTube.

empty.message: No videos found yet. Play the video, then open Spool again.

biliSignedOut.message: bilibili: not signed in, up to 480P. Sign in for 1080P.

biliBasic.message: bilibili: up to 1080P. Higher tiers need a membership.

biliVip.message: bilibili: membership, every quality your account can play.

errNeedLogin.message: Sign in to bilibili to save this video.

errRisk.message: bilibili is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.

errNoPermission.message: Your account cannot play this video.

errNoDash.message: No saveable streams for this video.
